lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_4 : BorelSpace E] (W : E → ℝ),
  ContDiff ℝ 1 W →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x)) MeasureTheory.volume →
      have μ := MeasureTheory.volume.tilted fun x => -W x;
      ∀ (D : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 μ) →ₗ.[ℝ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 2 μ)),
        D.IsClosable →
          (∀ (u : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 μ)) (G : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 2 μ)),
              (u, G) ∈ D.graph ↔ ∃ f, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧ ↑↑u =ᵐ[μ] f ∧ ↑↑G =ᵐ[μ] gradient f) →
            ∀ (u : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 μ)) (G : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 2 μ)),
              (u, G) ∈ D.closure.graph →
                ∀ (φ : E → ℝ),
                  ContDiff ℝ 1 φ →
                    HasCompactSupport φ →
                      ∀ (v : E),
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => φ x * inner ℝ (↑↑G x) v) μ ∧
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ↑↑u x * ((fderiv ℝ φ x) v - φ x * (fderiv ℝ W x) v)) μ ∧
                            ∫ (x : E), φ x * inner ℝ (↑↑G x) v ∂μ =
                              -∫ (x : E), ↑↑u x * ((fderiv ℝ φ x) v - φ x * (fderiv ℝ W x) v) ∂μ
approved_definition_context: Lp functions are equivalence classes modulo almost-everywhere equality; the displayed coercions choose measurable representatives.
A partial linear map has a linear domain and graph; IsClosable means its topological graph closure is again single-valued, and closure denotes that extension.
The tilted measure normalizes the density exp of its potential relative to the base measure.
ContDiff at order 1 means genuine continuously Frechet differentiable; the infinite order denotes smoothness. The gradient is the Riesz representative of the Frechet derivative.
